name: ai-workflow
description: Deterministic code-as-workflow engine for multi-agent orchestration ("Code, not conversation" — sandboxed TypeScript facades, typed agent RPCs, deterministic probing, zero-token durable replay, DAG visualization, MCP integration)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('.gate',{recursive:true})" && node scripts/link-self.mjs && node scripts/bootstrap-fixtures.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=.gate/tap.log dist/tests/unit/**/*.test.js dist/tests/integration/**/*.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/link-self.mjs && node scripts/bootstrap-fixtures.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/e2e/runner.ts
scripts.test:adversarial: node scripts/link-self.mjs && node scripts/bootstrap-fixtures.mjs && node --test --experimental-strip-types --test-concurrency=1 tests/adversarial/*.test.js tests/adversarial/*.test.ts tests/adversarial/demo1-dag-stress.js tests/adversarial/demo1-safety-stress.js tests/adversarial/demo2-concurrency-resumption-stress.js
scripts.gate: npm run build && node scripts/capture-failure-names.mjs && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:adversarial && npm run test:pbt && npm run test:governance
